doc_friction.issue: _job hard-codes the balance-table directories (crossset, calmap) via WL.SRC.get(cond, 'crossset'), so a new condition's tables cannot be registered by SRC alone; a new pool needs a loader patch

'Next: the fifth and sixth parameter sets' was carried forward through 7j to 7o without a check that any unused PyBaMM cell fades under the copied degradation parameters; earlier milestones' own benches (5g gate, 5k edge) already showed <3% energy fade for Mohtat2020, Ecker2015 and Marquis2019

deviations.why: Next said to bench the new sets through experiments/state7o/triage.py for wall time; accuracy needs 100-cycle runs anyway and the triage was degenerate on the one kept set, so the runner bench was skipped
deviations.did: 100-cycle x-resolved bench and the 7h lopo5 code only
deviations.result: the accuracy side settled the question (no usable fifth set) without the runner

notes: Pre-registered probe of 8 conditions on 4 unused PyBaMM cells: only Ramadass2004@1x fades (5.0% n_Li over cycles 2-20; others 0.08-0.61%). 45/56 Ramadass designs reached cycle 100; the ten-cycle forecast breaks (E99 q75 12.6), so the across-chemistry interval is unchanged (-7.53 to +0.33). Post hoc: Ramadass2004's positive OCP table is the only non-monotone one of 8. Tests: cell-fidelity 454 passed; build.py ok; check_md_links ok; check_posts ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: probe design, 100-cycle bench, pipeline adaptation, diagnosis and write-up for one milestone

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
